sentences.text: By way of the present petition filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C., petitioner prays for grant of anticipatory bail in case FIR No.374 dated 02.12.2022 registered under Sections 420/406/506/120B IPC at Police Station Barara, District Ambala.

In view of the above, the petitioners have made out a case for the grant of regular bail.
